gate_semantics.capacity_headroom: highest consecutive clean mixed90 width above c4 whose N=5 median output throughput rises over the preceding measured width
gate_semantics.percentile_method: nearest-rank except p50 uses the median of the full request population
gate_semantics.two_second_metric: content-bearing TTFT; full-response latency is published separately

protocol.cache_shape: mixed90 has nine full-prompt hits and one full cold miss per ten equal-sized prompts; eight hot cache namespaces carry the qualified fixed prompt and cold has a unique namespace per request
protocol.latency_clock: first visible response content, not SSE keepalive

workload.extension_rule: run the next width only while at least one model's clean mixed90 median output throughput rises over the preceding width
workload.requests_per_cell_rule: smallest multiple of 10 at least max(minimum_requests_per_cell, concurrency)
workload.thermal_regime: one server boot, no clock changes, no artificial cooldown; cold and mixed90 arms alternate
